patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: Honestly? I feel fine. The cough is annoying but I walked in here myself. My wife made me come. Can I go home after this?
clinical.presentationShort: 58yo M — 8 days COVID symptoms, comfortable at rest, no distress, walked in unassisted.
clinical.presentationLong: 58-year-old male, eight days of COVID symptoms, entirely comfortable at rest with no apparent distress, ambulatory and self-presenting.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → oxygen, chest X-ray, admission; he is far sicker than he appears
diagnosis.why: The badge IS the case. Silent hypoxaemia is COVID's signature trick: comfortable, chatty and profoundly hypoxic. Believe the number, not the vibe.
diagnosis.redFlag: SpO₂ 84% in a patient who looks and feels completely well — silent hypoxaemia.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a black 58-year-old man in a polo shirt and jeans, sitting comfortably on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting relaxed and at ease, one ankle crossed over the opposite knee, phone loosely in one hand
aiImageGeneration.expression: mildly bored and faintly amused, completely at ease
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: looks entirely well — the danger is invisible
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a black 58-year-old man in a polo shirt and jeans, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: caught MID-COUGH - turned slightly to one side with a loosely closed fist raised to his mouth and his shoulders rounding forward with the cough, while his body stays otherwise relaxed and settled back in the chair with one ankle crossed over the opposite knee. Expression: the scrunched momentary look of someone coughing into their fist - irritated by the cough but NOT frightened, NOT gasping and NOT in distress. Clearly visible: a fist raised to the mouth mid-cough; a relaxed, comfortable seated posture; completely normal skin colour with no blueness anywhere. Overall: a comfortable man with an annoying cough - the danger is invisible. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
